title: hot-path budget tests measure wall clock, so host load fails them on unchanged code
detail: tests/test_hook_hot_path.py test_pre_tool_owned_overhead_stays_within_coarse_budget (and the stop twin) time a subprocess against a bare interpreter by wall clock. With the Docker VM at ~140% CPU, the ratio is 2.25-2.69x against a 1.75 budget on HEAD, on 0cdcb18 and on origin/main 23479c3 (v0.238.8, which passed earlier). The same code passes and fails depending on host load, so a pass or fail says nothing about prusik. Candidate: measure child CPU time (resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) deltas) instead of wall clock, keeping the bare-interpreter ratio.
